name: Alternatingcaseandreversecipher

description_json.name: AlternatingCaseAndReverseCipher
description_json.idea: A highly intuitive, non-mathematical cipher designed for maximum semantic coherence. It reverses the entire text character-by-character, and then swaps the case of every alphabetic character (uppercase becomes lowercase, lowercase becomes uppercase). Non-alphabetic characters (numbers, spaces, punctuation) remain in their reversed positions but are otherwise unchanged. This completely breaks standard token sequences while being trivial for a language model to process and reverse perfectly.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Reverse the entire input string character-by-character.
2. For each character in the reversed string, if it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), convert it to lowercase (a-z). If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), convert it to uppercase (A-Z). Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the ciphertext string, if it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), convert it to lowercase (a-z). If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), convert it to uppercase (A-Z). Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
2. Reverse the resulting string character-by-character to restore the original plaintext.
